user.title: Connect Beat81
user.description:
You need a Beat81 **Bearer JWT** (access token). Home Assistant never opens a browser for Beat81 on this machine.

**How to get the token**
1. Sign in at the Beat81 website in a normal browser (same account you use for bookings).
2. Open your browser’s developer tools → **Application** (Chrome) or **Storage** (Firefox) → **Local storage** or **Session storage** for the Beat81 site, and look for a value that looks like a JWT (`eyJ…` three dot-separated parts).
3. Alternatively, if you use another tool or app that saves the session after login, copy the same Bearer token from there.
4. Paste the **entire** token below (no `Bearer ` prefix).

**After it expires** you must sign in again, obtain a new JWT, remove this integration and add it again with the new token (or reconfigure when supported).

**Network:** this host must reach `https://api.production.b81.io`.

init.title: Beat81
init.description:
**Two refresh speeds:** while you have at least one **waitlisted** class, the **waitlist** interval is used. When `waitlist_count` is **0**, the **idle** interval is used.

**Auto-promote (when enabled):** after a successful refresh, if any waitlisted class has a free spot **and** you do **not** already have another **booked** class on that **calendar day**, the integration calls the same **book** API as the **Promote waitlist** button for the **first** such class in the API list. If nothing qualifies, nothing is posted.

Very fast waitlist polling increases API load — use responsibly.
